caption: The drawing depicts three objects resembling medical or laboratory instruments, possibly swabs, arranged on a plain off-white or light beige background. Two objects are drawn within a larger rectangular frame positioned centrally on the paper. The upper object is elongated and slightly curved, with a rounded bulb at the left end and a flatter, wider shape at the right end. The lower object within the same upper rectangle is similarly elongated, but the left side is more flattened and oval-shaped, while the right end is broader and shaped like a rounded paddle. Below these two, within a smaller rectangle near the bottom of the composition, a simplified side-view outline of a similar object is depicted, showing a thin handle and a small oval at the left tip. The objects are rendered in gray or graphite tones, with careful shading to indicate texture and three-dimensional form, while the background remains untouched, highlighting the objects.
title: Silver Salt Spoon
